# Brutal

> Brutal is a high-end AI engineering agency. A focused team of experienced AI engineers embeds inside companies with complex operations, unique workflows, and deep internal knowledge to design, build, and ship custom AI/ML systems.

Brutal works with organizations whose operations do not fit off-the-shelf software. Instead of selling a product, Brutal places engineers directly alongside executives and internal teams, builds systems where the work actually happens, and treats AI as a competitive advantage rather than a threat to be managed.

The work falls into three areas. Executive visibility: connecting company knowledge across communications, reporting, and internal systems so leadership and operational teams can see what is going on. Workflow automation: building custom AI agents that take over high-volume, repetitive operational work and free teams for higher-value tasks. Custom AI/ML engineering: designing systems aligned with each client's data, workflows, and teams.

The engagement model has three steps. We embed: engineers work directly with executives and internal teams. We trace: they follow how work moves across systems and identify the highest-impact AI opportunities. We build: they ship systems into real use, then keep testing and improving them.

The site is available in English and German. Contact is through the "Get in touch" form on the homepage; there is no separate contact page.
